subject: white-sailed boat on cloud ocean
art_direction: 小白帆船像在云面航行，金光沿云浪边缘散开，画面下方层次丰富。
visible_description: 小白帆船像在云面航行，金光沿云浪边缘散开，画面下方层次丰富。
composition: Native vertical 1024x1536 phone wallpaper. Design the full tall canvas with convincing depth, elegant leading lines and a strongly resolved focal scene in the middle and lower areas. Leave the upper roughly 20% naturally quiet for a lock-screen clock, using open sky, mist, water, a wall or a gentle color field; do not draw any clock or UI. Do not put essential faces or details at the extreme sides. Use a full-bleed rectangular composition, no border, no circular frame. Let scale, texture, atmosphere and beautiful lighting create the impact. Preserve clarity instead of filling every area with ornament.
creative_direction: Imagine a white-sailed wooden boat gliding over a dense cloud ocean instead of water. Keep the boat small but distinct in the lower center, its sail catching warm light. Broad cloud swells form diagonal paths into the distance, with cool shadows between them. No crew is visible. Use luminous painted edges and a calm pale sky that becomes simpler and brighter toward the upper fifth. Vertical 1024x1536 for a phone wallpaper. Keep the upper 20% naturally quiet for the clock, with no lettering, logos, or watermark.
